8188675555375.title: Cross Body Bag
8188675555375.description:
Design Name : IBS-CBB26-005

Sleek and statement-making, this metallic gold crossbody bag features a structured silhouette with a clean envelope-style flap for a modern finish. Crafted from smooth, high-shine material, it offers a slim profile while keeping your essentials secure and organized. The adjustable shoulder strap allows for comfortable, hands-free wear, perfect for evenings out or elevating everyday looks.

  • Bag type: Crossbody Bag
  • Feature: Zipper Pocket/ 2 Compartments
  • Closure Details: Flap Closure with Magnet
  • Uses/Event: Casual/ All season
  • Color: Gold

Material & Craftsmanship:

  • Fabric: Faux Leather
  • Details: Metallic Faux Leather

Dimension:

  • Dimensions:5” L x 9” W x 1” D
  • Capacity: It comfortably fits most smartphones, a cardholder or slim wallet, keys, and small items like lipstick or compact powder. Its sleek 1-inch depth keeps it lightweight and ideal for minimal, on the go styling.
  • Strap Length & Type: 43” and Adjustable

Care Instructions:

  • Cleaning & Maintenance Guidelines
    • Use a microfiber cloth to remove dust and dirt. For light stains, wipe with a damp cloth and allow to air dry.
    • Keep out of direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use.
    • Keep your bag in a dust bag or soft cloth pouch to protect it from dust and scratches.
    • Keep your bag away from rough surfaces or sharp items that could cause damage.
    • Always test a small area before proceeding to clean the entire article

8065982038063.title: Mentor Aqua Deo For Men
8065982038063.description:
Fragrance Family: Woody Aromatic

Type: Men Deo Spray

Intensity: Strong

This enticing men’s fragrance mixes citrus, aromatic and woody accords for a bold and charming aroma that is sure to leave you turning heads in any room you enter. Top notes of juniper berries, Sicilian lemon, blood orange, and other bright citruses create a zesty and luminous atmosphere that immediately awakens the senses. Meanwhile, heart notes of lavender and herbal accords create a potent, spicy allure that’s impossible to ignore. Finally, base notes of woody amber enrich the entire concoction for a dazzling fragrance that you can wear with confidence.

8065982857263.title: Mentor Blanc Deo For Men
8065982857263.description:
Fragrance Family: Woody Spicy

Type: Men Deo Spray

Intensity: Soft

Combining elegance and style, it was designed with the modern man in mind. Vibrant with fresh and sensuous notes, the fragrance exudes distinction, sophistication and purity. Balancing with a fresh and fruity top note, the warm, spicy-floral heart is dominated by cinnamon with just a touch of cardamom. The base note is decidedly male with a vibrating harmony of musk and vetiver.

8065982169135.title: Mentor Bleu Deo For Men
8065982169135.description:
Fragrance Family: Aromatic Spicy

Type: Men Deo Spray

Intensity: Soft

Fresh and alluring fragrance. features top notes of orange, bergamot, marine and green, an invigorating yet soothing citrus-herbal blend. Then reveals a heart of coriander, jasmine, and violet before finishing with base notes of cedar, sandalwood, amber, musk.

8065983938607.title: Mentor Noir Deo For Men
8065983938607.description:
Fragrance Family: Aromatic Fougere

Type: Men Deo Spray

Intensity: Strong

The strength, insolence and emotion. A powerful scent with an explosive blend featuring stimulating lavender, lemon, and bergamot as top notes which play with a warm spicy herbaceous heart ending on a powerful musk base.

8065981874223.title: Mentor Rame Deo For Men
8065981874223.description:
Fragrance Family: Amber Spicy

Type: Men Deo Spray

Intensity: Mild

This elegantly sensual fragrance is the perfect choice for an adventurous soul. Blending citrus with cardamom, bergamot, and nutmeg to create a beguiling fragrance that exudes confidence. The heart features toffee, lavender, and violet undertones of precious woody amber.

8065983217711.title: Mentor Rouge Deo For Men
8065983217711.description:
Fragrance Family: Amber Woody

Type: Men Deo Spray

Intensity: Mild

A confident, masculine scent for the new millennium. The top notes of bergamot, lemon, orange, and crisp apple are assertive and fresh with a slightly astringent note. Floral is the dominant heart tone, with the fantasy scent of teak wood and lemony rose balancing its deep and exotic earthiness. Vanilla and musk highlight the teak wood and mesh together for a warm, rich fragrance that lends a sense of mystery as it lingers on the skin.

8293559337007.description:

Spirit Quad is a representation of classic sophistication and elegance. This fragrance is designed for the modern guy who radiates confidence and sophistication, blast of delicious apple, cinnamon and energising mandarin. Aromatic notes of rosemary and sage appear as the scent develops, giving the combination more depth and complexity. The comforting and seductive scent of lavender and patchouli is what defines the heart of scent. Produces a lasting impact with its lingering trail of sandalwood and olive wood, spirit quad is the pinnacle of classic sophistication, appropriate for any setting.

This fragrance evokes a sense of elegance and natural beauty, offering a sophisticated yet easy-to-wear perfume for those who appreciate quality and timeless charm.

8293559205935.title: Spirit Una For Women

opening whiff of delicate neroli immediately tempts the senses with its pleasant, flowery scent.
